The structure of ScAlCu crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Sc₄Al₄Cu₄) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: each Al and Cu center has 12 geometric neighbors (4 Al/Cu and 8 Sc), while each Sc center has 12 neighbors (6 Al and 6 Cu), all at distances of 2.84–2.95 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Al–Cu 12-vertex polyhedra sharing edges, and Al–Al, Cu–Cu, and Al–Sc pairs sharing corners, edges, and faces, with the neighbor graph forming a single three-dimensional component.
